description: Verified physics exercises for tutors, human or AI, in French (Swiss course conventions, decimal comma) or English. One topic, accelerated-motion: uniformly accelerated motion in a straight line (MRUA), first year of gymnase. A car or a motorbike starts from rest or with a speed v0 and reaches a speed v in a time t1; the student finds the acceleration a = (v - v0)/t1, the distance at a time with x(t) = v0·t + a·t^2/2 and the speed at another with v(t) = v0 + a·t, then sketches x(t), v(t) and a(t). Each exercise is built from its answers, so its answer key is always right. Each one sets a named trap, the error it tests: acceleration-graph (a(t) drawn at the height of the final speed), position-graph (x(t) drawn as a straight line instead of a parabola), forgotten-half (a·t^2 written for a·t^2/2), final-speed-times-time (the distance taken as v·t1), speed-in-km-h (the speeds given in km/h, used without converting). Returns the statement for the student and, for the tutor only, `solution.answers`: each quantity asked (acceleration, distance from t = 0, speed) with `at` (its time in s), `value` in SI units and `unit` (m/s^2, m, m/s); and explained steps with the trap step and its note; in the tutor view, a host that draws views also shows the three graphs behind a switch. Never show the solution to the student. To check a student's answer by substitution, each exercise carries `motion` { v0, a, duration } in SI units: x(t) = v0·t + a·t^2/2 and v(t) = v0 + a·t, from x = 0 at t = 0 to t = duration. Give a seed to get the same exercise again; its id names it. Give a date (YYYY-MM-DD) instead for the exercise of that day, the same for every reader. Deterministic: use this instead of writing exercises and answer keys yourself.

count.description: How many exercises, from 1 to 20. With a seed, they use seed, seed + 1, and so on.

date.description: The exercise of that day (YYYY-MM-DD), the same for every reader: today's date gives the exercise of the day. In place of a seed.

lang.description: Language of the statement and the solution: fr (Swiss course conventions) or en.

seed.description: The same seed (with the same trap) always gives the same exercise. Leave it out for a new one.

topic.description: accelerated-motion: uniformly accelerated motion in a straight line (MRUA), first year of gymnase: a body starts from rest or with a speed and reaches another in a time; find the acceleration, the distance and the speed at given times, and sketch x(t), v(t) and a(t).

trap.description: The error the exercise tests, one of its topic's. Leave it out and the seed chooses one; the answer names it.

view.description: What a host that draws views shows under the call. tutor: the exercise with its steps, solution and figure behind a switch, for a tutor reading this chat. student: the statement only, when the student reads this chat. The result carries the solution either way, for you. With student, the student reads your reply too: do not write the solution, the steps or the answer set in it; use them to check the student's work.
